04 · The problem

The client is already interested.
But they still need to make up their mind.

Often it’s not that your business isn’t good enough. The person simply hasn’t found the answers that help them take the next step.

They found you on 2GIS. Checked your Instagram. Maybe even opened your website.
But questions remain:

01

Is this service right for me?

02

Can I trust you?

03

How does it all work?

04

How much will it cost?

05

What happens after I get in touch?

Without answers, people fill in the gaps themselves. Sometimes they just put the decision off — or go with whoever was easier to understand.

Find out what’s holding my site back
05 · How I work

A website that answers doubts — so you don’t have to

What actually happens, from brief to finished site.

  1. 01

    Brief

    You fill in a short brief — about 15 minutes of your time. You tell me about your business, your clients and what’s currently getting in the way of enquiries.

    Outcome: a clear task and a starting point for research.
  2. 02

    Research

    I study your niche, your clients and how they go about choosing a service like yours. I look at competitors’ sites and real reviews to see which questions, expectations and objections need answering.

    Outcome: a clear picture of your audience, what they want and what your offer can be built on.
  3. 03

    Offer & structure

    I work out what to show first, which questions to answer and how to lead visitors to get in touch. I put together a page prototype and agree it with you before development starts.

    Outcome: the page logic, section structure and a clear offer.
  4. 04

    Copy, design & build

    I turn your strengths into clear messages, a visual system and an easy-to-use interface. Then I show you a working draft — all changes at this stage are free.

    Outcome: approved copy, design and a working draft of the site.
  5. 05

    Launch

    I test the site on different devices, connect your domain and set up enquiries to arrive in Telegram. You get an archive of all the files and a short video guide.

    Outcome: a live website, ready to receive enquiries.

  6. Where to start?

    Send a request — I’ll review your site or Instagram for free and tell you where it makes sense to start.

06 · What’s included

What you get along with the website

A carefully planned turnkey landing page — 120,000 ₸

Research & groundwork

  • Niche, competitor and audience analysis. So the site rests on what your clients really need and what your business does best.

  • Page structure and flow. I map out what a visitor should see, understand and do, from the first screen to the enquiry.

  • Website copy. I write it myself. No need for you to come up with headlines, service descriptions or calls to action.

Design & development

  • Custom design, no ready-made templates. I create a visual system for your business, grounded in usability, perception and modern web practice.

  • Search-friendly content. I take into account how people search for your services, so the site makes sense to search engines as well as to visitors.

  • Easy on a phone. Text is easy to read, buttons are easy to tap, and getting in touch never turns into a quest.

Launch & tech setup

  • Secure forms. Basic spam protection and checks that every form works correctly.

  • Pre-launch testing. I check responsiveness, key user flows and how the site looks on different devices.

  • Turnkey launch. I connect the domain, publish the site and hand over all the files, so the project stays yours.

Help with domain and hosting

  • I’ll help you choose and set them up, and explain everything in plain language.

30 days of edits after launch

  • So you can try the site in real life at your own pace and tell me what needs adjusting.

10 · FAQ

Honest answers — before you even ask

We go step by step, so there are no surprises. First we agree on the structure and copy (the prototype), and only then do I move on to visuals and the build. All changes at the draft stage are included in the price. We keep refining until you like the site and it works for your clients.

That’s common. I take care of all the copy: I interview you, study your clients’ reviews and write clear, meaningful headlines. For visuals, I’ll help you find quality graphics, put together a neat logo and build a consistent style.

The package covers everything: from research and copy to the build, mobile optimisation and setting up enquiries to arrive in Telegram. You only pay extra for add-ons you choose yourself (second language, calculator or quiz, express delivery — prices are in the “Add-ons” section) and for direct service costs: a domain (usually around 3,000–5,000 ₸ a year) and hosting, if you need a paid plan.

Development takes 5 to 12 working days. From you, it takes about 15–20 minutes to fill in the brief at the start, plus quick approvals at two stages (structure and final draft). No endless calls — everything clear and to the point.

After handover you get 30 days of free technical support. If you spot a mistake or want to tweak some text, I’ll fix it free of charge. You also get an archive of the files and a short video guide, so the project stays fully under your control.

Yes, everything is official. We set out the stages and commitments in a written agreement. Payment is split into two equal parts: 50% before work starts and 50% only after you approve the finished working draft, before it goes live.

Instagram works well with people who already follow you. A website answers questions before anyone has to message you: what you offer, what it costs, how it works and why you can be trusted. People find it through search and via the link on 2GIS, and enquiries land straight in your Telegram. Instagram and a website don’t compete — the site link fits perfectly in your bio.

The number of enquiries depends on traffic, demand and the service itself, so I won’t promise specific numbers — that wouldn’t be honest. What I’m responsible for is that anyone who lands on your site quickly understands your offer, finds answers to their doubts and can get in touch in a couple of taps.

You do. After launch I hand over an archive of all the files and a short video guide. The site isn’t tied to me — any developer can move it or build on it.
